verdict.rationale: Vestd's help doc describes an online exercise flow where the employee submits an exercise request and an admin reviews/processes it, confirming valuation and tax/legal considerations (vestd-docs-5), and separate docs show that issued shares are recorded digitally with automatic Companies House updates and no paperwork (vestd-docs-11, vestd-docs-8). However, there is no explicit evidence describing how the exercise payment itself is collected or processed within the platform, so the full 'exercise + payment + issuance' loop isn't fully documented as paperless. Missing for 10: explicit description of online payment collection for the exercise price, and confirmation that no manual/paper step occurs between payment and share issuance.
